jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
At Loblaw Digital, we know that our customers expect the best from us. Whether that means building the best, most innovative online shopping experience, or designing an app that will impact the lives of people across the country, we’re up for the challenge. From our office in Downtown Toronto, we’ve created leading eCommerce experiences in the online grocery shopping, beauty, pharmacy, and apparel spaces, and we’re only just getting started.

Why is this role important?

At Loblaw Digital, we know that our customers expect the best from us. Whether that means building the best, most innovative online shopping experiences, or designing an app that will impact the lives of people across the country, we’re up for the challenge. Loblaw Digital is the team responsible for building and operating the online businesses of Canada’s largest and most successful retailer. Based in downtown Toronto, we are an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and collaborative team working towards transforming the way Canadians shop by creating leading eCommerce experiences in the online grocery shopping, beauty, pharmacy, loyalty, and apparel spaces, and we’re only just getting started! To achieve these goals, we are looking for talented and passionate individuals who want to collaborate and solve challenging problems and make significant and lasting impact on Canadians.

As a Director, Strategy & Operations, you will report to the Sr. Director, Strategy and Operations. You will partner with business and functional leadership teams at Loblaw Digital to develop strategic plans that identify opportunities, risks and metrics to measure outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Independently lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurement
Form hypotheses, conduct research and develop quantitative analyses that identify and size opportunities, risks and strategic choices
Create concise executive narratives and materials for leadership meetings, enterprise forums, external meetings and company-wide communications
Design and implement improvements to organizational processes, governance, operating rhythms and cross-functional ways of working
Build alignment between Loblaw Digital leaders and Loblaw enterprise partners, resolve dependencies and help teams move from discussion to decision

Does this sound like you?

Seven or more years of relevant experience, with progressively greater responsibility
A demonstrated record of taking ambiguous questions from initial hypothesis through analysis, recommendation, implementation and measurable outcome
Strong analytical capabilities, including the ability to work hands-on with data, quantify opportunities and risks, test assumptions and build compelling business cases
Experience influencing senior leaders and resolving disagreement without relying on formal authority
Strong execution and change-leadership skills, including the ability to establish plans, governance and measures of success
A record of coaching colleagues, developing talent and improving the quality of a team’s work
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex issues clear and facilitate productive executive discussions
Curiosity about digital consumer experiences, retail and e-commerce and emerging technologies

How You’ll Succeed

At Loblaw Digital, we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections. We’re able to keep innovating because our colleagues are passionate about their work and excited about the future of eCommerce. You will get to work with some of the best digital minds and will have the support of world class technologies to craft products our customers will love!

How You’ll Succeed:

At Loblaw Digital, we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

We’re able to keep innovating because our colleagues are passionate about their work and excited about the future of eCommerce.

If you have big ideas, undeniable enthusiasm, and thrive in a collaborative, creative, and diverse group, we’ll get along just fine.

Looking for a challenge? Good. Love an innovative work environment? Even better.

Apply today.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Position Overview

Reporting to the SVP, Pharmacy, the Director, Strategy & Operations is a strategic partner to the Pharmacy Operations & Transformation leadership team, responsible for driving strategic planning, operational excellence, business transformation, and execution of enterprise and divisional priorities.

The Director translates complex business priorities into actionable plans, executive insights, and measurable outcomes. Key accountabilities include coordinating the Multi-Year Plan (MYP), Current Year Plan (CYP), leading cross-functional initiatives, and developing high-quality Board of Directors and executive leadership materials.

The role also champions artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline processes, and enhance decision-making. Success requires strong strategic thinking, executive communication, analytical capabilities, and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Executive Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor to the SVP and leadership team, providing strategic insights, business recommendations, and execution support.
Lead coordination of MYP, CYP, strategic reviews, and business planning processes.
Align cross-functional priorities, accountabilities, milestones, and measurable outcomes across Pharmacy and enterprise partners.
Anticipate business challenges, identify opportunities, and support executive decision-making.

Board & Executive Communications

Lead development of Board, Board Committee, Executive Leadership Team, and senior management presentations, briefing materials, and strategic reports.
Translate complex financial, operational, and strategic information into compelling, concise, data-driven narratives and actionable recommendations.
Manage executive reporting processes, coordinating stakeholder inputs, timelines, quality assurance, and final deliverables.
Anticipate leadership questions and ensure materials demonstrate accuracy, strategic alignment, and executive-level quality.

Strategic Initiatives & Transformation

Lead complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives and transformation programs from planning through implementation and value realization.
Establish project governance, workplans, milestones, accountabilities, risk mitigation, and performance reporting.
Facilitate executive steering committees, strategic workshops, and decision-making forums.
Drive change management, process redesign, implementation, and benefits realization across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, and Loblaw Companies Limited.

AI, Technology & Automation

Champion responsible adoption of generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve productivity, efficiency, and business performance.
Identify and implement AI-enabled solutions for research, analysis, reporting, presentations, workflow management, and executive decision support.
Partner with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and business teams to prioritize and deliver automation and digital transformation opportunities.
Promote AI literacy, innovation, and continuous improvement while ensuring alignment with enterprise security, privacy, and governance standards.

Operational Excellence & Business Insights

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize business processes, operating models, and workflows.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives delivering measurable productivity gains, operational efficiencies, and cost savings.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, business cases, and performance reporting to support strategic decisions and track results.
Conduct business analysis, scenario planning, and opportunity assessments, translating insights into actionable recommendations.

Leadership, Collaboration & Governance

Build strong relationships across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, Loblaw, and enterprise functions, driving alignment and accountability.
Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver shared objectives in a matrixed organization.
Coordinate executive meetings, strategic planning sessions, leadership communications, and governance forums.
Maintain confidentiality, sound judgment, and operational discipline while championing innovation and results-oriented execution.

Skills, Experience & Education

Strategic & Business Capabilities

Strong background in strategic planning, business transformation, operational excellence, and complex program execution.
Broad understanding of pharmacy operations, healthcare, retail, and enterprise business strategy.
Strong business acumen, financial literacy, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving.
Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives, manage competing priorities, and translate strategy into execution.

Executive Communication & Leadership

Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience developing Board and C-suite materials.
Advanced PowerPoint capabilities, executive storytelling, and ability to synthesize complex information into clear, decision-oriented recommendations.
Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, influencing skills, and cross-functional leadership.
Excellent judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

AI, Technology & Digital Expertise

Advanced proficiency in generative AI and digital productivity tools, with demonstrated ability to improve analysis, reporting, workflows, and business outcomes.
Experience identifying and implementing automation, AI-enabled processes, and technology-driven operational improvements.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, Power BI, or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
Understanding of responsible AI, information security, data privacy, and technology governance.

Role Requirements

5+ years of progressive experience in strategy, operations, transformation, consulting, or related leadership roles, preferably in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, or a complex corporate environment.
Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, healthcare administration, or a related discipline; MBA or graduate education preferred.
Proven experience supporting senior executives, developing Board-level materials, and executing enterprise strategic initiatives.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects, transformation programs, process improvements, and change management.
Practical experience applying AI, digital tools, and automation to improve business productivity and operational performance.
Strong ability to facilitate strategic discussions, influence without direct authority, and balance enterprise strategy with hands-on execution.
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or equivalent certification is an asset.
Knowledge of Loblaw and Shoppers Drug Mart systems, processes, and performance metrics is an asset.

Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy .

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Does working with some of Canada’s most talented minds in innovation supporting retail, digital consumer solutions and analytical platforms excite you? Loblaw Technology powers some of Canada’s most game-changing retail solutions, giving our customers the ability to live their lives well.

Come work with a team that values diverse ideas, fosters a culture of inclusion and develops our talent from within. Loblaw Technology gives you the chance to excel, and helps you to strive for success in a big way. Keep reading to learn more!

Please note the Loblaw hybrid work model is 4 days in office

Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications

We are looking for a highly technical, business-oriented Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications to help lead the strategy, modernization, and evolution of our Virtual Care program within Pharmacy and Healthcare Technology.

This role will look across the end-to-end Virtual Care ecosystem, including the current solution, business capabilities, technology architecture, operational dependencies, provider experience, integrations, vendor landscape, and future growth opportunities. This role will bring thoughtful leadership to ensure the solution evolves into a long-term, scalable, resilient, and strategically aligned healthcare platform.

The successful candidate will partner closely with business, digital, operations, architecture, engineering, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams to ensure the continued success of the Virtual Care program. This individual will bring forward innovative ideas, provide practical recommendations, influence key decisions, and help shape a roadmap that supports business growth, improved patient and pharmacy experiences, and operational excellence.

This technical leadership role requires a seasoned hands-on leader who can operate at every level — from shaping business strategy to diving deep into complex technical solutions alongside their teams. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, bridging the gap between business priorities and technology execution, while charting a clear path from the program's current state to an elevated future state.

What You'll Do

Provide strategic and technical leadership across the end-to-end Virtual Care program.
Assess the current Virtual Care solution focused on the provider experience, including its strengths, weaknesses, risks, dependencies, scalability, stability, and long-term viability.
Develop a strong understanding of the business, product, operational, and technology landscape supporting Virtual Care.
Partner with business, digital, product, operations, architecture, engineering, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams to shape and evolve the Virtual Care roadmap.
Bring forward innovative ideas, solution options, and strategic recommendations that help improve provider experience and efficiency while supporting long-term business objectives.
Influence key decisions by clearly outlining business value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, complexity, timelines, and long-term sustainability.
Guide technology choices, application design, architecture direction, and modernization opportunities.
Ensure Virtual Care solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, technology strategy, security expectations, privacy requirements, and healthcare technology objectives.
Work with delivery teams to remove blockers, improve execution velocity, and ensure initiatives remain aligned to roadmap priorities.
Partner with operations teams to improve application stability, resiliency, supportability, monitoring, incident response, and production performance.
Provide guidance to engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, reliable, and designed for future growth.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Prepare and present recommendations, decision points, roadmap options, risks, and trade-offs to support informed decision-making.
Collaborate across a matrixed environment and build alignment between business needs, digital priorities, technical strategy, and operational realities.
Support investment planning, vendor discussions, technology evaluations, and business cases related to the Virtual Care platform.
Help ensure technology investments deliver meaningful value to patients, pharmacy teams, healthcare professionals, and the broader organization.

What You'll Bring

An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience in technology leadership, enterprise consulting, solution architecture, application development, or a related field, ideally within healthcare, pharmacy, digital health, or another regulated environment.
Proven ability to serve as a senior technology advisor or solution leader in complex, matrixed enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end technology ecosystems, including applications, integrations, infrastructure, cloud, data, security, operations, vendors, and user experience.
Experience assessing current-state environments and developing practical future-state roadmaps, modernization strategies, architectural proposals, and business cases.
Strong knowledge of modern architecture and development practices, including cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, enterprise integration, and legacy modernization.
Ability to evaluate technology options and recommend solutions that balance business value, technical complexity, cost, risk, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.
Experience guiding application modernization, platform stabilization, technology consolidation, cloud transformation, vendor evaluation, platform selection, and technology investment planning.
Proven ability to influence decisions and build alignment across business, technology, operations, vendors, executives, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

If you’re up to the challenge, then we would love to hear from you. Apply today, and get the process started.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Finance
jobs.description:
Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

Position Overview

The Director, Commercial Finance, will lead the Commercial Finance capability supporting Enterprise Sourcing’s Cost transformation strategy at Canada’s leading Food and Drug Retailer. The role is accountable for establishing annual value targets, maintaining an enterprise-wide view of sourcing performance, and ensuring that negotiated supplier value is accurately assessed, actively managed, and realized.

As a senior finance partner to Sourcing, Merchandising, Divisional Finance leadership, the Director will provide strategic insight and financial governance across the full value lifecycle—from target setting and deal valuation through performance tracking and value realization.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, FPA, this role will be responsible for leading a dedicated Commercial Finance team and play a critical role in supporting one of the key strategic areas of the Enterprise.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Target Setting and Financial Planning

Partner with Sourcing Leadership team to develop financial building blocks to support annual, quarterly and periodic targets by BU
Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into the timing, composition, and achievability of planned value on a periodic basis

Deal Valuation and Financial Governance

Establish and maintain a consistent methodology for determining incremental deal value.
Evaluate key deal assumptions, including baselines, volumes, timing, implementation profiles, mix impacts, and incremental value.
Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis team to confirm that agreed deal value and execution commitments are reflected in financial forecasts

Performance and Value Management

Establish reporting standards to evaluate value leakage is identified early and actively addressed
Review actual and forecast performance against annual and periodic targets as well as against overall volume and category impacts
Identify emerging value gaps, delivery risks, and opportunities requiring management attention.
Provide clear and timely reporting to executive leadership on value realization, financial risks, and required interventions.

Strategic Business Partnership

Serve as the senior Commercial Finance partner to Sourcing, Merchandising, and Divisional Finance leadership.
Provide financial perspective and constructive challenge on sourcing strategies, supplier negotiations, and value assumptions.
Support leadership discussions concerning supplier performance, cost gaps, category economics, and program priorities.

Team and Capability Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Finance team.
Establish clear accountabilities, operating rhythms, analytical standards, and performance expectations.
Build scalable value-management processes, tools, scorecards, and management reporting.
Coach the team on commercial analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder management.
Promote strong collaboration across Commercial Finance, FP&A, Sourcing, Merchandising, and Divisional Finance.

Qualifications And Experience

University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.
+10 years of progressive experience in commercial finance, strategic finance, FP&A, sourcing finance, category finance, analytics or a related area.
Demonstrated experience leading complex financial planning, target setting, and performance-management processes.
Strong understanding of commercial value drivers, cost of goods, supplier economics, and deal valuation.
Strong financial modelling skills in Excel, analytical, and management-reporting capabilities required.
Experience partnering with senior executives and influencing cross-functional decisions.
Proven people-leadership experience, including developing high-performing finance teams.
Retail, consumer goods, sourcing, procurement, or merchandising experience is strongly preferred.
Experience with tools such as Power BI, MicroStrategy, SAP, is an asset.

Our commitment to Sustainability and Social Impact is an essential part of the way we do business, and we focus our attention on areas where we can have the greatest impact. Our approach to sustainability and social impact is based on three pillars – Environment, Sourcing and Community – and we are constantly looking for ways to demonstrate leadership in these important areas. Our CORE Values – Care, Ownership, Respect and Excellence – guide all our decision-making and come to life through our Blue Culture. We offer our colleagues progressive careers, comprehensive training, flexibility, and other competitive benefits – these are some of the many reasons why we are one of Canada’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers & Canada’s Top Employers for Young People.

If you are unsure whether your experience matches every requirement above, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are looking for varied perspectives which include diverse experiences that we can add to our team.

We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.

Please Note

Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation
jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Reporting to the VP, Pharmacy Operations, Clinical Excellence and Transformation, the Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation will lead the strategy and execution of transformational initiatives shaping the future of pharmacy at Shoppers Drug Mart.

This role will own the pharmacy AI, technology, automation and optimization agenda
, while ensuring that the patient and pharmacy team experience remains at the centre of transformation. The successful candidate will identify and scale opportunities that improve how patients access and experience pharmacy care, simplify pharmacy workflows, enhance team member experience and deliver measurable operational and business value.

Working closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence, and other cross-functional partners, this leader will translate emerging capabilities, patient and team insights, and business opportunities into a clear transformation strategy and roadmap. They will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, taking initiatives from early-stage discovery and business case development through implementation, adoption, and scale.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Pharmacy Experience and Transformation strategy and roadmap, with a strong focus on AI, automation, technology and the evolving needs of patients and pharmacy teams.
Own the pharmacy AI agenda, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve patient experience, pharmacy workflows, team member experience and operational performance.
Lead a portfolio of key transformation initiatives, including Experience Insights & Analysis, Pharmacy Experience Program (PEP), Rx Delivery, AI Call Agent and Assisted Data Entry.
Translate strategic opportunities into scalable solutions, leading initiatives from discovery, concept development and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
Champion a patient- and team-centred approach to transformation, ensuring new technology and process changes make pharmacy interactions simpler, more seamless and more meaningful.
Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify and automate pharmacy workflows, reducing administrative burden and enabling pharmacy teams to spend more time supporting patients and delivering care.
Use patient feedback, pharmacy team insights, operational data, market trends and emerging technology to identify opportunities and shape the future pharmacy experience.
Partner closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence and other teams to align business priorities, technology capabilities and investment against the transformation roadmap.
Lead experience discovery and analysis to better understand patient and team member pain points, unmet needs and emerging expectations, and translate those insights into actionable transformation priorities.
Establish clear success measures across patient experience, pharmacy team experience, operational performance and financial value, and monitor outcomes to ensure initiatives are delivering meaningful impact.
Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, bringing clarity and structure to complex transformation opportunities and driving decisions required to move initiatives forward.
Lead and develop a high-performing team with a strong culture of strategic thinking, innovation, experimentation, accountability and execution.

What You’ll Need

Senior leadership experience in strategy, AI, digital transformation, technology, customer experience or large-scale business transformation.
Demonstrated ability to develop transformation strategies and take complex initiatives from concept and business case through implementation and scale.
Strong understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to improve customer or patient experience, frontline workflows and operational efficiency.
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure and direction to complex or ambiguous opportunities.
A strong human-centred mindset, with demonstrated ability to translate patient, customer and frontline team needs into meaningful experience improvements.
Strong business acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, build compelling business cases and connect transformation investments to measurable value.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across operations, technology, digital and business teams.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around a transformation agenda.
Experience using data, insights and performance measures to inform strategy, prioritize opportunities and assess impact.
Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, technology, consulting or another complex operating environment.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Reporting to the VP, Pharmacy Operations, Clinical Excellence and Transformation, the Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation will lead the strategy and execution of transformational initiatives shaping the future of pharmacy at Shoppers Drug Mart.

This role will own the pharmacy AI, technology, automation and optimization agenda
, while ensuring that the patient and pharmacy team experience remains at the centre of transformation. The successful candidate will identify and scale opportunities that improve how patients access and experience pharmacy care, simplify pharmacy workflows, enhance team member experience and deliver measurable operational and business value.

Working closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence, and other cross-functional partners, this leader will translate emerging capabilities, patient and team insights, and business opportunities into a clear transformation strategy and roadmap. They will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, taking initiatives from early-stage discovery and business case development through implementation, adoption, and scale.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Pharmacy Experience and Transformation strategy and roadmap, with a strong focus on AI, automation, technology and the evolving needs of patients and pharmacy teams.
Own the pharmacy AI agenda, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve patient experience, pharmacy workflows, team member experience and operational performance.
Lead a portfolio of key transformation initiatives, including Experience Insights & Analysis, Pharmacy Experience Program (PEP), Rx Delivery, AI Call Agent and Assisted Data Entry.
Translate strategic opportunities into scalable solutions, leading initiatives from discovery, concept development and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
Champion a patient- and team-centred approach to transformation, ensuring new technology and process changes make pharmacy interactions simpler, more seamless and more meaningful.
Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify and automate pharmacy workflows, reducing administrative burden and enabling pharmacy teams to spend more time supporting patients and delivering care.
Use patient feedback, pharmacy team insights, operational data, market trends and emerging technology to identify opportunities and shape the future pharmacy experience.
Partner closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence and other teams to align business priorities, technology capabilities and investment against the transformation roadmap.
Lead experience discovery and analysis to better understand patient and team member pain points, unmet needs and emerging expectations, and translate those insights into actionable transformation priorities.
Establish clear success measures across patient experience, pharmacy team experience, operational performance and financial value, and monitor outcomes to ensure initiatives are delivering meaningful impact.
Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, bringing clarity and structure to complex transformation opportunities and driving decisions required to move initiatives forward.
Lead and develop a high-performing team with a strong culture of strategic thinking, innovation, experimentation, accountability and execution.

What You’ll Need

Senior leadership experience in strategy, AI, digital transformation, technology, customer experience or large-scale business transformation.
Demonstrated ability to develop transformation strategies and take complex initiatives from concept and business case through implementation and scale.
Strong understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to improve customer or patient experience, frontline workflows and operational efficiency.
Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure and direction to complex or ambiguous opportunities.
A strong human-centred mindset, with demonstrated ability to translate patient, customer and frontline team needs into meaningful experience improvements.
Strong business acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, build compelling business cases and connect transformation investments to measurable value.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across operations, technology, digital and business teams.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around a transformation agenda.
Experience using data, insights and performance measures to inform strategy, prioritize opportunities and assess impact.
Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, technology, consulting or another complex operating environment.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams through significant change and transformation.
Post-Secondary education in Industrial or Process Engineer / Technology / Business/ Healthcare or Operations
7-10 years' experience, retail preferred
MBA or relevant advanced degree is an asset.
Must be available to travel across Canada as required.

Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy .

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

Employment Type

Full time

Type Of Role

Regular

We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the products we sell, the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization. In addition, we believe that compliance with laws is about doing the right thing. Upholding the law is part of our Code of Conduct – it reinforces what our customers and stakeholders expect of us.

As Director, Control Brand Transformation

This is a newly created role accountable for helping the SVP translate strategic priorities into a clear operating rhythm, integrated workplans, executive-ready materials, decision forums, follow-ups, and cross-functional accountability. You will work directly with the SVP on priority workstreams including brand transformations, Board and executive materials, annual planning, governance, and critical cross-functional initiatives. Ensure materials reflect strategic clarity, commercial logic, enterprise impact, and credible execution plans.
Act as the single point of coordination across teams and stakeholders for SVP-led transformation priorities.

Travel with the SVP to key meetings where required, ensuring context, decisions, actions, and follow-ups are captured and advanced.
